design: Compile frozen H274 actual and mixture centered residual polynomials: full mean-linear + within-core + core-partner terms. No native tensors needed for correction inference. Compare compiled-only, common linear+within, actual, mixture and exact residual oracle. Native intact write is common conditional baseline; direct source perturbation retained. Fresh128 docs exclude1728 prior hashes. No fitting/tuning. Float64 compiler audit, float32 executable evaluation, float64 KL from float32 logits.

gates.cross_behavior: actual correction reduces common conditional KL>=10%, paired95 lower>0 BOTH actual scales
gates.mixture_angle_advantage: mixture reduces actual-only conditional KL>=5%, paired95 lower>0 BOTH angle scales
gates.mixture_actual_retention: mixture improvement over actual-only paired95 lower>−3% BOTH actual scales
gates.half_kl: actual correction reduces compiled-only conditional KL>=50% BOTH actual scales

scope: Conditional mediation using exact native intact baseline, NOT intact model replacement. Dense linear/full-output coefficient costs included. No semantic claim.
